summary: Aspire Biopharma Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K solely to clarify warrant terms for holders after two reverse stock splits (1-for-30 on Jan 16, 2026 and 40-for-1 on May 11, 2026). The warrants now have an exercise price of $13,800 per share and a 1,200:1 exercise ratio. No transaction, event, or special situation is disclosed—this is a routine clarification of instrument terms with no corporate action, acquisition, activist, or restructuring content. Hence, this filing does not trigger a special-situations classification.
